passages.text: Aechmea coelestis is a species in the genus Aechmea. This is a species that is native to southeastern Brazil from Espírito Santo to Santa Catarina.Kew World Checklist of Selected Plant FamiliesSant'Ana Melhem, T., das Graças Lapa Wanderley, M., Ehlin Martins, S., Jung-Mendaçolli, S.L., Shepherd, G.J. & Kirizawa, M.
